original_caption: Autonomous Control and Artificial Intelligence in Drones | Fig. 1: Integration of AI in Autonomous Drone Systems. The figure presents a hierarchical architecture of AI-driven modules  for drone autonomy, including (1) SLAM, (2) neural network-based, (3) computer vision, (4) edge AI processors, and (5)  AI-enhanced flight controllers for adaptive navigation.
